headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4 in a thrilling matchup, with Zack Wheeler pitching a strong 7.0 innings for the Phillies. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs. In other news, the Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras hitting his 12th home run of the season. The New York Yankees also took down the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, securing a crucial win in their latest matchup.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with DL Hall of the Milwaukee Brewers placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left pectoral strain. Other players on the injured list include Ryan Fernandez of the St. Louis Cardinals, Garrett Crochet of the Boston Red Sox, Aaron Judge of the New York Yankees, Jonathan India of the Kansas City Royals, Trevor Story of the Boston Red Sox, Sean Murphy of the Atlanta Braves, and Joe Mantiply of the Toronto Blue Jays.

There have been several trades and roster movements in the past 24 hours. The Boston Red Sox acquired Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates, while the Cincinnati Reds traded Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Atlanta Braves acquired Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels for cash, and the Toronto Blue Jays acquired Simeon Woods Richardson from the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Phillies in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4, securing a crucial win. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched a strong 7.0 innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras leading the charge at the plate. Contreras hit his 12th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field, and finished with 2 hits and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, securing a crucial win in their latest matchup. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 12-9 win. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs, winning 18-3 in a lopsided game. Edward Cabrera led the Giants' pitching staff, while Casey Schmitt and Bryce Eldridge were among the impact hitters for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Brewers Place DL Hall on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have placed left-handed pitcher DL Hall on the 15-day injured list due to a left pectoral strain.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Bolster Rotation with La Sorsa Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa, acquired in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. La Sorsa joins the Red Sox after the trade was announced.
